description.value: Mi Casa Mexicana is a family-owned Mexican restaurant that opened in December 2019 on Burrard Street in Vancouver, rooted in a culinary tradition dating back to their grandmother's cooking in 1970s Mexico. The menu focuses on handmade pozole, birria, tacos, and tamales built from family recipes and daily-fresh ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a warm sit-down spot with takeout available and gluten-free options on the menu.
